name: 61606 · Peoria, IL
findings: ZIP 61606 (Peoria) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61606 (Peoria) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
